name: Discord
summary: Bring the server channels, threads, and direct messages of a Discord bot into the Chat sidebar, grouped by server.

license.terms: Included under the ForkMesh repository licence.

permissions.label: Connect to the Discord bot API and Gateway as the bot token you provide
Place the bot channels, threads, and direct messages in the Chat sidebar and transcript
Keep the bot token and cached Discord history on this device until the package is removed

screenshots.alt: Chat sidebar with a collapsible Discord · Forkmesh group of bridged channels beside native ForkMesh channels
